summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests carboplatin, paclitaxel and pembrolizumab given before surgery, followed by olaparib and pembrolizumab, in newly diagnosed stage III or IV ovarian cancer. Carboplatin, paclitaxel and pembrolizumab are given before surgery to remove the tumor, and olaparib and pembrolizumab are given after surgery as maintenance; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome measured is not stated, and the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa carboplatino, paclitaxel y pembrolizumab administrados antes de la cirugía, seguidos de olaparib y pembrolizumab, en cáncer de ovario en estadio III o IV de diagnóstico reciente. Carboplatino, paclitaxel y pembrolizumab se administran antes de la cirugía para extirpar el tumor, y olaparib y pembrolizumab se administran después de la cirugía como tratamiento de mantenimiento; la duración o la frecuencia no están indicadas. El resultado principal que se mide no está indicado, y el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Newly diagnosed stage III or IV epithelial ovarian, peritoneal or fallopian tube cancer
Candidate for carboplatin and paclitaxel before planned interval debulking surgery
CA-125 to CEA ratio of 25 or greater, or a negative workup if lower
not_for: Mucinous, germ cell or borderline ovarian tumor
Prior treatment for advanced or metastatic ovarian cancer
Prior olaparib or any other PARP inhibitor
Known HIV, hepatitis B, or active hepatitis C infection
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
